bests_card_subtitle: Your fastest efforts, picked up automatically from your workouts.

coach_scores_explainer: Your AI coach rates these from 1 to 10 when it reviews your workouts and builds your athlete profile. They are its judgement, not measurements; the charts above are calculated directly from your data.
coach_scores_explainer_nutrition: Your AI coach rates these from 1 to 10 when it reviews your workouts and nutrition logs and builds your athlete profile. They are its judgement, not measurements; the charts above are calculated directly from your data.
coach_scores_summary: AI ratings out of 10 for fitness, recovery, consistency and workout execution.

headline_footnote: Fitness is your long-term training load (CTL). Form is fitness minus recent fatigue (TSB): a little below zero is normal while you build. Both are calculated from your logged sessions.

intensity_card_guideline: Most endurance coaches aim for roughly 80% of training time easy (zones 1–2) and 20% moderate or hard.
intensity_empty_body: Record sessions with a heart-rate monitor or watch to see how your time splits between easy and hard.
intensity_empty_title: No heart-rate or power data in this period
intensity_source_hr: Based on {hours} h of heart-rate data in this period.
intensity_source_power: Based on {hours} h of power data in this period.
intensity_verdict_close: {easy}% of your time was easy, a little under the ~80% guideline. Keeping easy days truly easy helps you recover for the hard ones.
intensity_verdict_polarised: {easy}% of your time was easy, in line with the ~80/20 guideline.
intensity_verdict_too_hard: Only {easy}% of your time was easy, well under the ~80% guideline. Too much moderate or hard work builds fatigue faster than fitness.
no_insights_available: No insights available. Click "Generate Insights" to create them.
pmc_card_explainer: Fitness (CTL) is your training load averaged over about six weeks; fatigue (ATL) covers the last week. Form (TSB) is fitness minus fatigue.
pmc_card_healthy_pattern: A healthy pattern: fitness rising steadily by a few points a week, form slightly negative while you build, and back above zero after an easy week or before a race.
power_curve_card_description: Your best average power for efforts from 5 seconds to an hour.
progress_meta_description: See how your training is going: fitness trend, goal countdown, weekly volume, intensity balance and personal bests.
sections_modal_description: Choose which sections appear on your Progress page.
